messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.inference>

Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro call — security & compliance discovery (Greenfield Health)

Hi Sara — thanks again for the intro call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on what Greenfield needs from us to move the procurement and security review forward.

Summary of asks we discussed:
- SOC 2 status: redacted reports, system description, and any recent audit findings
- GDPR/HIPAA applicability: you indicated HIPAA applies (thanks for confirming) — we will surface BA/DPA options
- Vendor security questionnaire: you asked that we kick off your standard questionnaire and own the responses
- Incident response / breach notification: you asked about our notification timeline and escalation chain
- BCP/DR evidence: DR test summary, RPO/RTO, and any recent DR exercises

What I will do this week:
- Share a redacted copy of our latest SOC 2 Type I summary and system description (by EOD 5/5) — we cannot share an in-progress Type II yet, but will provide the most recent artifacts and a timeline for Type II.
- Share a redacted IR playbook excerpt and DR test summary (by 5/7)
- Kick off your vendor questionnaire (link below) and suggest a short kickoff meeting to walk the security team through the answers and any required evidence (proposed 5/7 or 5/10)

Questions for Greenfield:
1) Confirm the procurement/legal contact who should receive the DPA/BA template (I have procurement@greenfieldhealth.com and legal@greenfieldhealth.com).
2) For incident notification SLA, do you require contract language for a 48-hour notification window, or is 72 hours acceptable (we generally operate on a confirmed-incident notification within 72 hours; we can escalate to 48h for contracts with that clause)?
3) Any particular evidence formats you prefer (PDF redaction, SOC extracts, signed attestations)?

Attachments: meeting-recording-20260504.mp4 (recording of the intro call)
Useful links: vendor questionnaire doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-greenfield-questionnaire

Proposed next steps:
- Tessa to share SOC 2 Type I summary + system description (5/5)
- Marcus to share IR playbook excerpt + RTO/RPO values (5/7)
- Kickoff call for questionnaire (proposed 5/7 11:00am PT) — Neha will send invite

If that aligns, we’ll get those documents over and Neha will send a calendar invite for the kickoff. Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Sara — answered inline for the technical items you flagged: 

> Procurement prefers a redacted Type II if available; if not, Type I + system description + control mapping is acceptable.
We do not have a SOC 2 Type II finalized yet. Status: Type II audit fieldwork completed Feb 2026; final report expected Q3 2026.
What I can provide now: a redacted SOC 2 Type I summary, the system description, and our control mappings (we will mark any vendor-sensitive configuration values). Attached: soc2-type-i-summary.pdf (redacted).

> Breach notification: prefer 48-hour notification window — can Redwood accommodate?
High level on our practice: we operate under two lanes: (1) confirmed incidents that meet the definition of personal data compromise — we notify customers within 72 hours and provide an initial incident summary with indicators; (2) for customers under contract with a 48-hour clause, we can accept the 48-hour notification commitment with a contractual addendum, and we have an internal priority path to support that. If Greenfield needs 48h by default, we will flag that as a commercial/legal term and escalate.

Quick IR playbook excerpt (attached as redwood-ir-playbook-redacted.pdf):
- Triage & containment: initial 2-hour incident triage target for incidents affecting production ML inference plane
- Customer notification: initial notification with scope and mitigation steps within 72 hours of confirmation (48h contractual option available as noted)
- Root cause & remediation plan: published within 5 business days for complex incidents
- Post-incident review: 30-day remediation plan and follow-up deliverables

RTO/RPO (summary):
- Critical inference path: RTO = 1 hour, RPO = 15 minutes (KV-cache replication + multi-region failover)
- Control plane metadata: RTO = 4 hours, RPO = 1 hour

Attachments: redwood-ir-playbook-redacted.pdf, soc2-type-i-summary.pdf

If helpful, I can prepare a single redacted evidence bundle for the questionnaire to reduce back-and-forth.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
